message: This assistance, valued at $200.7 million, was targeted at the most vulnerable groups totaling some nine million people, including those affected by natural disaster, conflict, returned refugees and internally displaced peoples.
message_es: Esta asistencia, valorada en 200,7 millones de dólares, se dirigió a los grupos más vulnerables, que suman unos nueve millones de personas, incluidos los afectados por desastres naturales, conflictos, refugiados repatriados y desplazados internos.
retro_en: This assistance, valued at $200.7 million, targeted the most vulnerable groups, which number about nine million people, including those affected by natural disasters, conflicts, returning refugees and internally displaced persons.

message: Witnesses to recent abuses told Human Rights Watch both in Mali and by phone that government soldiers tortured two men, summarily executed two, and forcibly disappeared at least six others.
message_es: Testigos de abusos recientes dijeron a Human Rights Watch tanto en Malí como por teléfono que soldados del gobierno torturaron a dos hombres, ejecutaron sumariamente a dos y desaparecieron por la fuerza al menos a otros seis.
retro_en: Witnesses of recent abuses told Human Rights Watch both in Mali and over the phone that government soldiers tortured two men, summarily executed two men and forcibly disappeared at least six others.

message: The agency plans to provide psychological counselling and set up educational and recreational facilities for traumatised children.
message_es: El organismo tiene previsto prestar asesoramiento psicológico y establecer instalaciones educativas y recreativas para los niños traumatizados.
retro_en: The agency plans to provide psychological counselling and educational and recreational facilities for traumatized children.

message: UNICEF recently donated 300 kilograms of UNIMIX, the high-protein porridge, as well as essential medicines to local health authorities in establishing the center.
message_es: El UNICEF donó recientemente 300 kilogramos de UNIMIX, la avena de alta proteína, así como medicamentos esenciales a las autoridades sanitarias locales para establecer el centro.
retro_en: UNICEF recently donated 300 kilograms of UNIMIX, high protein oats, as well as essential medicines to local health authorities to establish the centre.

message: The rains also affected sections of the Royal Palace of Rwoth Alur located in Winam village, a house in Obayo village, an incomplete structure in Yamu Center village and a grass thatched house in Winam village.
message_es: Las lluvias también afectaron a secciones del Palacio Real de Rwoth Alur, situado en la aldea de Winam, una casa en la aldea de Obayo, una estructura incompleta en la aldea del Centro Yamu y una casa de paja en la aldea de Winam.
retro_en: Rain also affected sections of the Royal Palace of Rwoth Alur, located in the village of Winam, a house in the village of Obayo, an incomplete structure in the village of the Yama Centre and a straw house in the village of Winam.

message: An increase in livestock sales has resulted in a substantial decline in auction prices south of the veterinary cordon fence.
message_es: El aumento de las ventas de ganado ha dado lugar a una disminución sustancial de los precios de las subastas al sur de la valla de cordón veterinario.
retro_en: The increase in livestock sales has led to a substantial decrease in auction prices south of the veterinary cordon fence.

message: The assistance, expected to be delivered in coming weeks, initiates broader IAEA support to African Member States to strengthen their technological abilities to detect diseases transmitted from animals to humans - zoonotic diseases.
message_es: La asistencia, que se espera que se preste en las próximas semanas, inicia un apoyo más amplio del OIEA a los Estados Miembros africanos para fortalecer su capacidad tecnológica de detectar enfermedades transmitidas de los animales a los seres humanos - enfermedades zoonóticas.
retro_en: Assistance, expected to be provided in the coming weeks, initiates broader IAEA support to African Member States to strengthen their technological capacity to detect animal-borne diseases - zoonotic diseases.

message: Numerous seismic aftershocks, bad weather and rough terrain continue to complicate relief efforts across the affected region.
message_es: Numerosas réplicas sísmicas, mal tiempo y terreno accidentado siguen complicando las actividades de socorro en toda la región afectada.
retro_en: Numerous seismic replicas, bad weather and rugged terrain continue to complicate relief efforts throughout the affected region.

message: Umdowoban, on the eastern outskirts of Khartoum near the Blue Nile, also suffered heavy damage.
message_es: Umdowoban, en las afueras orientales de Jartum, cerca del Nilo Azul, también sufrió graves daños.
retro_en: Umdowoban, on the eastern outskirts of Khartoum, near the Blue Nile, also suffered serious damage.

message: Some 10,000 workers couldn't go to work at industrial zones.
message_es: Unos 10.000 trabajadores no podían ir a trabajar a las zonas industriales.
retro_en: Some 10,000 workers were unable to go to work in industrial areas.

message: The area around Ishinomaki, the most seriously affected by the 2011 Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami, was among those which suffered the most damage to services and facilities, with the local Red Cross hospital experiencing power interruptions and a number of evacuation centres still lacking adequate water supplies.
message_es: La zona de Ishinomaki, la más afectada por el terremoto y tsunami de Tōhoku de 2011, fue una de las que sufrió más daños a los servicios e instalaciones, con el hospital local de la Cruz Roja sufriendo interrupciones de energía y varios centros de evacuación todavía carecen de suministro de agua suficiente.
retro_en: The Ishinomaki area, the most affected by the 2011 earthquake and tsunami in Tohoku, was one of the areas most damaged by services and facilities, with the Red Cross local hospital suffering power disruptions and several evacuation centers still lacking sufficient water supply.

message: Distribution of 420,000 family hygiene parcels has been completed in seven operational areas (Meulaboh, Teunom, Calang, Lam No, Aceh Besar, Pidie and Lhokseumawe), with another 30,000 food parcels distributed on Nias in early February.
message_es: Se ha completado la distribución de 420.000 paquetes de higiene familiar en siete zonas operacionales (Meulaboh, Teunom, Calang, Lam No, Aceh Besar, Pidie y Lhokseumawe), y a principios de febrero se distribuyeron en Nias otros 30.000 paquetes de alimentos.
retro_en: The distribution of 420,000 family hygiene packages has been completed in seven operational areas (Meulaboh, Teunom, Calang, Lam No, Aceh Besar, Pidie and Lhokseumawe), and an additional 30,000 food packages were distributed in Nias in early February.

message: WHO, together with the government of Afghanistan and several international NGOs, launched an appeal for a little over one million US dollars to bring the disfiguring disease -cutaneous leishmaniasis - commonly called the Kandahar sore, under control.
message_es: La OMS, junto con el gobierno de Afganistán y varias ONG internacionales, hizo un llamamiento para que se controlara la enfermedad desfigurante -leishmaniasis cutánea-, comúnmente llamada llaga de Kandahar.
retro_en: WHO, together with the Afghan government and several international NGOs, called for the control of the disfigured disease - skin leishmaniasis - commonly called the Kandahar sore.

message: -- Restoration of the $37.5 million in DOD drawdown authority that was used for response to immediate humanitarian needs in Southern Africa.
message_es: - Restablecimiento de la autoridad de reducción del Departamento de Defensa por valor de 37,5 millones de dólares que se utilizó para responder a las necesidades humanitarias inmediatas en el África meridional.
retro_en: - Restoration of the Department of Defense reduction authority of $37.5 million that was used to respond to immediate humanitarian needs in southern Africa.

message: The aim of the project (NCRMP-I) is to improve early warning and communication systems; enhance capacity of local communities to respond to disasters; improve access to emergency shelters, evacuation, and protection against cyclone related hazards such as wind storms, flooding and storm surge in high risk areas; and strengthen disaster risk management capacities at the central, state and local levels.
message_es: El objetivo del proyecto (NCRMP-I) es mejorar los sistemas de alerta temprana y comunicación; aumentar la capacidad de las comunidades locales para responder a los desastres; mejorar el acceso a refugios de emergencia, la evacuación y la protección contra los peligros relacionados con los ciclones, como tormentas eólicas, inundaciones y tormentas en zonas de alto riesgo; y fortalecer la capacidad de gestión de los riesgos de desastre en los planos central, estatal y local.
retro_en: The project (NCRMP-I) aims to improve early warning and communication systems; enhance the capacity of local communities to respond to disasters; improve access to emergency shelters, evacuation and protection from cyclone-related hazards, such as windstorms, floods and storms in high-risk areas; and strengthen disaster risk management capacity at the central, state and local levels.

message: The size of evacuation camps varies in each location and diseases such as respiratory tract infection, skin disorders, body aches, diarrhea and gastritis are commonly seen.
message_es: El tamaño de los campamentos de evacuación varía en cada lugar y se observan enfermedades como infecciones del tracto respiratorio, trastornos de la piel, dolores corporales, diarrea y gastritis.
retro_en: The size of evacuation camps varies at each location, with diseases such as respiratory tract infections, skin disorders, body pain, diarrhoea and gastritis.

message: Separately, the Palu city administration in Central Sulawesi has deployed four excavators to dredge sediment to deepen the Kawatuna River, which separates east and west Palu, in an effort to prevent flooding in the area.
message_es: Por otra parte, la administración de la ciudad de Palu en Sulawesi Central ha desplegado cuatro excavadoras para dragar sedimentos a fin de profundizar el río Kawatuna, que separa Palu oriental y occidental, en un esfuerzo por evitar inundaciones en la zona.
retro_en: In addition, the administration of the town of Palu in Sulawesi Central has deployed four dredging diggers to deepen the Kawatuna River, which separates eastern and western Palu, in an effort to prevent flooding in the area.

message: Denied an effective voice and largely ignored by those in power, many residents of Al-Duwayqa, and other 'unsafe areas' continue to live in fear on precarious hillsides or under high voltage power lines because they have nowhere else to go.
message_es: Negado una voz efectiva y en gran medida ignorado por los que están en el poder, muchos residentes de Al-Duwayqa y otras "zonas inseguras" siguen viviendo con miedo en laderas precarias o bajo líneas de alta tensión porque no tienen a dónde ir.
retro_en: Denied an effective voice largely ignored by those in power, many residents of Al-Duwayqa and other "unsafe areas" continue to live in fear on precarious slopes or under high-voltage lines because they have nowhere to go.

message: Building on progress made over the last six months, the OCHA-RSO will keep its focus on sub-regional coordination, humanitarian monitoring, planning and response, the coordination of protection, the promotion of inter agency assessments, the pursuance of closer collaboration with United Nations and non-UN human security actors, and the use of advocacy to highlight vulnerability and neglected crises.
message_es: Sobre la base de los progresos realizados en los últimos seis meses, la Oficina de Coordinación de Asuntos Humanitarios y de Seguridad Regional seguirá centrándose en la coordinación subregional, la supervisión, la planificación y la respuesta humanitarias, la coordinación de la protección, la promoción de evaluaciones entre organismos, la colaboración más estrecha con los agentes de seguridad humana de las Naciones Unidas y de fuera de las Naciones Unidas, y el uso de actividades de promoción para poner de relieve la vulnerabilidad y las crisis desatendidas.
retro_en: Building on the progress made over the past six months, the Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs and Regional Security will continue to focus on subregional coordination, humanitarian monitoring, planning and response, protection coordination, promotion of inter-agency assessments, closer collaboration with United Nations and non-United Nations human security actors, and the use of advocacy to highlight vulnerability and underserved crises.

message: It was not immediately clear exactly how the victims died, with reports that some had drowned after being knocked unconscious and falling into the flood waters.

retro_en: "All the tracks, taxi tracks and aprons have been cleared of volcanic ash," Air Base Commander Adi Soemarmo, Colonel Agus Radar Sucahyo, on Thursday.

message: In northeastern Afghanistan, huge mudslides and powerful aftershocks are terrifying quake survivors huddling without food or shelter in the mountains.
message_es: En el noreste de Afganistán, enormes deslizamientos de lodo y fuertes réplicas son aterradores sobrevivientes del terremoto que se amontonan sin comida ni refugio en las montañas.

message_es: En el cuarto de 36 metros cuadrados con paredes de madera, un techo de metal, una cocina abierta y dos camas improvisadas, Ibu Aja Cut, por primera vez desde el desastre, ve el rayo de esperanza.
retro_en: In the 36 square meters room with wooden walls, a metal roof, an open kitchen and two improvised beds, Ibu Aja Cut, for the first time since the disaster, sees the ray of hope.

message: Heavy rainfalls in Northern Togo have washed away a significant portion of cultivated land, over 30,000 houses have been destroyed, as well as 6 dams.

message: Upon completion of the project, rice, maize and other crop yields are expected to increase substantially, and savings of around 52 million-kilowatt hours of electricity are anticipated.

message: More than half of Afghanistan's 22 million people, 85 percent of whom live a subsistance lifestyle, have been affected by the drought, the worst in memory.
message_es: Más de la mitad de los 22 millones de personas de Afganistán, el 85% de las cuales viven en condiciones de subsistencia, se han visto afectadas por la sequía, la peor de la memoria.
retro_en: More than half of Afghanistan ' s 22 million people, 85 per cent of whom live on subsistence conditions, have been affected by drought, the worst memory.

message: ROK Coast Guard, navy vessels and fishing boats, accompanied by several helicopters attempted to prevent the slick from spreading, using a boom and chemical dispersants.
message_es: La Guardia Costera de la República de Corea, los buques de la marina y los barcos de pesca, acompañados de varios helicópteros, intentaron impedir que el astillado se propagara, utilizando un auge y dispersantes químicos.
retro_en: The Coast Guard of the Republic of Korea, navy vessels and fishing vessels, accompanied by several helicopters, attempted to prevent the splinter from spreading, using a boom and chemical dispersants.

message: Even in the northern regional capital of Kidal, a stronghold of Mali's Tuareg rebellion and the scene of recent deadly ethnic violence, voters cast their ballots in an atmosphere of calm, although the turnout was thought to have been low.

retro_en: Even in the northern regional capital of Kidal, a stronghold of Mali's Tuareg rebellion and the scene of recent deadly ethnic violence, voters cast their votes in a calm atmosphere, although participation was thought to have been low.

message: To compound the disaster, the flooding also brought fatal infections.

retro_en: World Vision India provides two power generators to schools to ensure the safety and protection of children.

message: The retirement of the incumbent president of the Viet Nam Red Cross (VNRC) took effect in June , with an official handover to the vice-president/acting secretary-general in July.
message_es: La jubilación del actual presidente de la Cruz Roja de Viet Nam (CVRV) entró en vigor en junio, con una transferencia oficial al vicepresidente/secretario general en funciones en julio.
retro_en: The retirement of the current President of the Viet Nam Red Cross (CVRV) came into effect in June, with an official transfer to the current Vice President/Secretary-General in July.

message: He explained that the drought caused numerous challenges among communities that largely depend on cattle farming for their livelihood.

retro_en: He explained that drought caused many problems among communities that depended heavily on livestock for their livelihood.

message: Initially, the UN Children's Fund (UNICEF) has distributed energy biscuits, kitchen kits and blankets; the Ministry of Health and the World Health Organization are providing medicines and water purification; UNHCR has provided 500 tents drawn from stockpiles in Douala, Cameroon, and is coordinating the response.

retro_en: Over 100 tsunami-affected villagers in southern Thailand received loans from a USAID-funded community revolving fund project that provides seed capital for microenterprise development.

message: ISDPP is one of IDS's key research partners in China, engaged in work on health and social security reform, and as a regional coordinator and grant recipient under the SPA (Social Protection in Asia) program.

retro_en: ISDPP is one of the IDS' main research partners in China, working on health and social security reform, and as regional coordinator and grant recipient under the social protection programme in Asia.

message: AmeriCares is providing 3.1 million water purifying sachets to be distributed through training programs to replenish water stocks for three camp-based water and sanitation programs in Kenya and for communities suffering famine in southern Ethiopia.
message_es: AmeriCares está proporcionando 3,1 millones de sobres de depuración de agua para distribuirlos mediante programas de capacitación para reponer reservas de agua para tres programas de agua y saneamiento en campamentos en Kenya y para comunidades que sufren hambre en el sur de Etiopía.
retro_en: AmeriCares is providing 3.1 million water purification envelopes for distribution through training programmes to replenish water reserves for three water and sanitation programmes in camps in Kenya and for hungry communities in southern Ethiopia.

message: Islamabad (dpa) - Eight U.S. chinook helicopters arrived in Islamabad from neighboring Afghanistan on Monday to join daunting relief and rescue operations in Pakistan's quake-hit areas and its administered Kashmir region.

message: In the three camps of Amilcar Cabral, DAF and Nhambulo 2 in Caia district, diseases are beginning to emerge due to overpopulation and lack of hygiene facilities.

retro_en: In the three camps of Amilcar Cabral, DAF and Nhambulo 2 in Caia district, diseases are beginning to arise due to overpopulation and lack of hygiene facilities.

message: Six people were killed after a passenger ferry sank in the central Philippines on Saturday amid rough weather as the storm approached, the navy said.
